\begin{document}
We use fermionic Matsubara frequencies, where $\omega_n = (2n+1)\pi/\beta$ with integer $n$, and $\beta>0$.
The imaginary-time integral of the phase factor is
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\beta} d\tau\, e^{i\omega_n\tau} = \frac{2i}{\omega_n} .
\label{eq:mats}
\end{equation}
